title: Formal gate: verification instead of votes
description: Replace the swarm's majority vote with a certificate. The trusted model writes a contract from the problem statement only (it never sees code, descriptions or reviews, so colluders cannot argue with it), and every submission is searched for a concrete counterexample by z3-backed symbolic execution (CrossHair), property-based fuzzing, and inputs the trusted model proposes after reading the code. Counterexamples are confirmed by execution. Adapts the formalizer / verifier agent loop of jaebooker/formal_verification_swarm (Coq) to Python with an SMT backend.
